title: Reliable local recipe launches and recovery
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-1 is the first Debian-revision maintenance release for 0.2.7, focused on reusing verified model weights, truthful launch progress, and safer recovery on DGX Spark clusters.
changes: Reuse already-downloaded Hugging Face model weights instead of copying or downloading them again for each recipe launch.
Verify model artifacts once per node, retain the resulting evidence through activation, and show byte-level progress and time estimates while verification runs.
Keep recipe preparation and launch work running independently from the Model Manager so closing or reopening the modal does not interrupt it.
Harden recipe validation, abort, cleanup, privilege separation, and stale-process recovery paths across local and two-Spark launches.
Correct model inventory, storage access, update-center permissions, and Cloudless Doctor recovery actions.
Adopt Debian-native maintenance release numbering so subsequent 0.2.7 fixes can ship as 0.2.7-2, 0.2.7-3, and later revisions.
